given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner submits a delivery proof that fails validation checks
given_when_then.then: The system generates a Dispute Ticket and blocks fund release

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner submits a delivery proof that is missing required elements
given_when_then.then: The system generates a Dispute Ticket and blocks fund release

given_when_then.given: The system retrieves a proof via an external API that lacks a valid timestamp or signature
given_when_then.when: The proof is verified against system standards
given_when_then.then: The system generates a Dispute Ticket as if it were locally captured

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner submits a proof for a Delivery Assignment marked as cancelled
given_when_then.when: The system checks the Delivery Assignment status
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the delivery proof

success_criteria: A Dispute Ticket is created immediately upon detection of validation failure or missing required elements.
Funds are withheld from the Store Partner until the Dispute Ticket is resolved.
External API proofs are subjected to the same verification standards as locally captured proofs.
Delivery proofs for cancelled assignments are rejected without generating a Dispute Ticket.
The system logs the specific reason for the Dispute Ticket (validation failure or missing elements).
